source: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates (daily)
convention: eur_per_unit — multiply the native price by this to get EUR (same convention as the existing inline FX table in build_price_ledger.py)
quoted_as: the ECB quotes units of currency per euro; eur_per_unit = 1 / quoted
note: ECB reference rates are published for information and are not a deal rate. They are used here so a Norwegian, Danish or US price can be recorded in euro at all; they replace no negotiated rate.
supersedes: the inline FX = {'EUR':1.0,'GBP':1.17,'SEK':0.089} working table (as_of 2026-05-01, described in the ledger as 'not official')
